title: Molecular Strategies of Carbohydrate Binding to Intrinsically Disordered Regions in Bacterial Transcription Factors.
authors: Purtov, Yuri A; Ozoline, Olga N
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟与碳水化合物对接研究细菌转录因子内在无序区与糖配体结合，虽非TF-DNA直接互作，但聚焦TF构象动态与配体传感，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制建模。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered regions enable transcription factors (TFs) to undergo structural changes upon ligand binding, facilitating the transduction of environmental signals into gene expression. In this study, we applied molecular modeling methods to explore the hypothesis that unstructured inter-domain and subdomain linkers in bacterial TFs can function as sensors for carbohydrate signaling molecules. We combined molecular dynamics simulations and carbohydrate docking to analyze six repressors with GntR-type DNA-binding domains, including UxuR, GntR and FarR from Escherichia coli, as well as AraR, NagR and YydK from Bacillus subtilis. Protein models obtained from different time points of the dynamic simulations were subjected to sequential carbohydrate docking. We found that the inter-domain linker of the UxuR monomer binds D-fructuronate, D-galacturonate, D-glucose, and D-glucuronate with an affinity comparable to nonspecific interactions. However, these ligands formed multimolecular clusters, a feature absent in the UxuR dimer, suggesting that protein dimerization may depend on linker occupancy by cellular carbohydrates. D-glucose interacted with linkers connecting subdomains of the LacI/GalR-type E-domains in GntR and AraR, forming hydrogen bonds that connected distant structural modules of the proteins, while in NagR, FarR and YydK, it bridged the inter-domain linkers and a beta-sheet within the HutC-type E-domains. Hence, our results establish flexible linkers as pivotal metabolic sensors that directly integrate nutritional cues to alter gene expression in bacteria.
abstract_zh: 固有无序区域使转录因子（TFs）在配体结合时能够发生结构变化，从而促进环境信号转导为基因表达。在本研究中，我们应用分子建模方法探讨了一个假设，即细菌转录因子中无结构的域间和亚域连接子可作为碳水化合物信号分子的传感器。我们结合分子动力学模拟和碳水化合物对接，分析了六种具有GntR型DNA结合域的阻遏蛋白，包括来自大肠杆菌的UxuR、GntR和FarR，以及来自枯草芽孢杆菌的AraR、NagR和YydK。从动态模拟的不同时间点获得的蛋白质模型进行了顺序碳水化合物对接。我们发现，UxuR单体的域间连接子与D-果糖醛酸、D-半乳糖醛酸、D-葡萄糖和D-葡萄糖醛酸的结合亲和力与非特异性相互作用相当。然而，这些配体形成了多分子簇，这一特征在UxuR二聚体中缺失，表明蛋白质二聚化可能依赖于细胞碳水化合物对连接子的占据。D-葡萄糖与连接GntR和AraR中LacI/GalR型E-结构域亚域的连接子相互作用，形成氢键，连接了蛋白质的远距离结构模块，而在NagR、FarR和YydK中，它桥接了域间连接子和HutC型E-结构域内的β-折叠。因此，我们的结果确立了柔性连接子作为关键代谢传感器，直接整合营养信号以改变细菌中的基因表达。
